# Overrides for exact pins that semgrep declares, so the hash-locked semgrep.txt can pick up
# security fixes semgrep has not adopted yet. semgrep.yaml installs semgrep.txt with --no-deps,
# so pip does not re-apply semgrep's own pins at install time.
# Regenerate semgrep.txt with the command in its header. Delete an entry once semgrep itself
# requires the patched version (check its metadata on PyPI), and delete this file when empty.

# GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (Dependabot alerts #35, #36): semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0; fixed in 1.30.0.
# semgrep imports mcp only for its MCP server, never in `semgrep scan`.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2

# GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (Dependabot alert #38): semgrep pins opentelemetry-api~=1.37; fixed in 1.45.1.
# The OpenTelemetry Python packages release in lockstep (SDK/exporter/proto 1.x.y with
# instrumentation/semantic-conventions 0.(x+21)bN), and the 1.37 SDK fails to import against a
# newer API, so the whole family moves together. Delete this block when semgrep's own pins reach it.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-proto>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions>=0.66b1,<1
opentelemetry-instrumentation>=0.66b1,<1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests>=0.66b1,<1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading>=0.66b1,<1
opentelemetry-util-http>=0.66b1,<1
